name: Rice Dumplings
description: Historical recipe from Common Sense in the Household (1871). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: rice boiled without stirring, until soft, and at the top dry
ingredients.originalText: 1 lb. rice boiled without stirring, until soft, and at the top dry

instructions.text: Let the rice cool upon a sieve or coarse cloth, that it may dry at the same time
Dip your dumpling cloths in hot water; wring them out and flour well inside
Put a handful of the cold rice upon each, spreading it out into a smooth sheet
Lay in the centre an apple
Fill the hole left by the core with marmalade or jelly
Draw up the cloth carefully to enclose the apple with a coating of rice
Pour sweet sauce or rich sweetened cream over them, and send around more in a boat with them

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Let the rice cool upon a sieve or coarse cloth, that it may dry at the same time
2. Dip your dumpling cloths in hot water; wring them out and flour well inside
3. Put a handful of the cold rice upon each, spreading it out into a smooth sheet
4. Lay in the centre an apple
5. Fill the hole left by the core with marmalade or jelly
6. Draw up the cloth carefully to enclose the apple with a coating of rice
7. Tie and boil one hour
8. Turn over with care
9. Pour sweet sauce or rich sweetened cream over them, and send around more in a boat with them
